findings.title: expect.text reports verified:true for text that is not visible: inside an open shadow root whose host is display:none, and inside a display:none iframe
findings.repro: probes/audit-server.mjs /p.html; MCP browser.click {target:'#noop', expect:{text:'SHADOW-HIDDEN-TEXT'}} -> verified:true 0.9 (same for 'IFRAME-HIDDEN-TEXT'); reproduced on the sutradhar bundle
findings.rootCause: execution-verifier.ts visibleTextContainsInPage uses child.innerText of shadow-root children and document.body.innerText in every frame; innerText of a node that is not being rendered returns its textContent
findings.contradicts: AGENT_SETUP.md, packages/mcp-server/README.md, MCP expectDesc ('hidden/display:none text does not count'); spec D6/N29; decision 4.8
findings.fix: gate shadow children and frame documents on rendering (Element.checkVisibility() or getClientRects().length, and the frame's documentElement), add unit + live negatives (hidden shadow host, display:none iframe, visibility:hidden iframe)
